liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **To Lay Me Down** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls this their favorite version and the show's highlight; Reviewer calls it solid, with great Jerry vocals, enhanced by the hushed crowd [19][21][24]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry's vocals are clear on this version [17]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Reviewer considers this a superior version, despite rarely enjoying the song [24]
- **Deep Elem Blues** (1 review): Reviewer was searching for the best electric version of this song and judged this one not the best [15]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Reviewer ranks this among the best versions they've heard [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-11-28.nak700.kocky.76519.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 151 min [1]. Said about its sound: Splices after Passenger and between Drums and Space were edited out, along with digital noise before U.S. Blues [1]
- **gd1980-11-28.nak700.wagner.miller.90013.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 158 min; rated 1.8/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the Nakamichi 700 recording impeccable [24]
- **gd1980-11-28.nak700.gmb.89932.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 151 min [3]. Said about its sound: Crossfades applied between nearly all first-set songs and before To Lay Me Down and U.S. Blues [3]
- **gd1980-11-28.mtx.tobin.90057.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 150 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd80-11-28.sbd.vernon.20049.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 4.08/5 by 13 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard hissy, like a seventh-generation cassette, with Bob's vocal sounding too high [15]
- **gd1980-11-28.sbd.vernon.tobin.fix-20049.90062.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 150 min; rated 4/5 by 9 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says this soundboard sounds better than most boards [22]
- **gd80-11-28.naks.clugston.2222.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 149 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [9]. Said about its sound: Audience tape was apparently made from one side of the stage; some instruments are clear, others less so; Audience recording sounds full and clear; the audible crowd doesn't distract and arguably improves the tape; Audience recording sounds great, getting especially sweet in the second set [17][18][21]

## Around the show

- Reviewer hears the band playing to a heavily tripped-out crowd and stoking them further [13]
- Reviewer stood about ten feet from Garcia on a very low stage; Garcia wore a short-sleeved collared shirt [20]
- Audience was quiet and attentive during songs, which made the recording especially sweet [21]
- Reviewer counts this among their favorite 1980 shows; sound pretty good [14]
- Reviewer ranks this audience tape alongside late-1980 audience tapes from Long Beach, Swing, Radio City and the southern run [18]
- Reviewer followed the tour from Miami to Georgia and found the band physically low-key compared with the Sportatorium [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-11-28.nak700.kocky.76519.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Bill Koucky; source: FOB Audience Cassette; Nakamichi CM700 mics> Sony D5> DAT [1]. Also: Remaster done through Wavelab from a DAT; Feel Like A Stranger moved to the end of disc 1 so the show fits two discs [1]
- **gd1980-11-28.nak700.wagner.miller.90013.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 (With Bass EQ) -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/TDK SA-X90/Dolby DB) D [2]
- **gd1980-11-28.nak700.gmb.89932.flac16**: transferred by Bill Koucky; source: FOB Nakamichi CM 700 > Sony D-5 Cassette Master > DAT [3]. Also: Second remaster of the Nakamichi 700 recording, with edits and mastering at 24 bit [3]
- **gd1980-11-28.mtx.tobin.90057.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: See info file [4]. Also: Matrix mix of soundboard and audience sources, aligned in Audition 3.0 and encoded to DTS with Surcode [4]
- **gd80-11-28.sbd.vernon.20049.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]. Also: Soundboard: cassette master to reel to DAT to CDR via Andy Lemieux and Kingbee [5]
- **gd1980-11-28.sbd.vernon.tobin.fix-20049.90062.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Remaster of shnid 20049 [6]
- **gd80-11-28.naks.clugston.2222.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nak CM700's [9]
